te: Battle of Hohenlinden: French General Jean Victor Marie Moreau decisively defeats the Archduke John of Austria near Mun…
dz: 第二联军之战:霍亨林登战役:法国将领让·维克多·玛丽·莫罗在慕尼黑附近决定性地击败了奥地利的约翰大公. 再加上第一执政官拿破仑·波拿巴先前在马伦戈的胜利,这将迫使奥地利人签署停战协议并结束战争.
de: War of the Second Coalition: Battle of Hohenlinden: French General Jean Victor Marie Moreau decisively defeats the Archduke John of Austria near Munich. Coupled with First Consul Napoleon Bonaparte's earlier victory at Marengo, this will force the Austrians to sign an armistice and end the war.
